description: Response-type validation boundaries reported via redirect. An empty-string response type and a case-mismatched 'CODE' (selectors are case-sensitive) both produce the same invalid_request / 'Invalid or missing response type' redirect, with the caller's state echoed. Requesting the implicit 'token' response type while implicit is disabled redirects with unsupported_response_type.
